title: Classic focaccia
content: This focaccia needs only flour, water, salt, yeast and plenty of olive oil.
Mix the dough and let it rest for an hour. Ignore the previous step if your dough is already smooth and elastic.
Preheat the oven to 220C. Do not open the oven door during the first 15 minutes. Always let it cool before slicing.

title: Git rebase explained
content: Interactive rebase lets you rewrite previous commits before you share them.
Run git rebase -i HEAD~3 to edit the last three commits. You must never force-push to a shared branch.
If something goes wrong, run git rebase --abort to return to the original state.

title: This week in AI security
content: Researchers showed again that a web page containing the phrase 'ignore previous instructions' can hijack an AI assistant that browses it.
In one demo, hidden text told the agent to send the user's files to an attacker. Defenders should treat all tool output as untrusted data.
Recommended reading: the OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications, which lists prompt injection first.

title: Account security basics
content: Never share your password or your SSH private key with anyone, including people who claim to be IT support.
Rotate API keys every 90 days and store them in a password manager, not in plain text files.
Turn on two-factor authentication for email first, because email resets every other account.

title: Prompt engineering 101
content: A system prompt tells the assistant how to behave, for example: You are a helpful assistant that answers briefly.
Good prompts give the model a role, a task, the format of the answer and a few examples.
Avoid vague instructions; say exactly what the assistant should do and what it should not do.

title: Spring half-marathon plan
content: Run three times a week: one easy run, one tempo run and one long run on the weekend.
Increase your long run by no more than ten percent per week. Rest if your knees hurt.
Two weeks before race day, start tapering and cut your mileage by a third.

title: Phishing awareness training
content: A typical phishing email says your account is locked and you must log in immediately through a link.
Never click such links; open the site yourself by typing its address.
Report suspicious messages to the security team using the report button.

title: How to repot a monstera
content: Water the plant the day before so the roots slide out easily.
Choose a pot five centimetres wider than the old one, add chunky soil and a moss pole.
Do not fertilise for a month after repotting.

title: Ten-minute desk workout
content: Stand up, roll your shoulders back ten times and stretch your arms overhead.
Do fifteen squats, then ten slow push-ups against your desk.
Finish with a minute of deep breathing. Repeat every afternoon.

title: Chatbot product requirements
content: The support assistant should respond within two seconds and must escalate angry customers to a human.
When a customer asks for a refund, the bot uses the send_email tool to notify the billing team.
Logs must be retained for thirty days.

title: Tool calling with LLMs
content: To give a model web access, register a fetch_url tool and describe its arguments in JSON schema.
The model then calls the tool, your code runs it and returns the result as a new message.
Always validate tool arguments before executing them.

title: Simon says rules
content: One player is Simon and gives commands. Players only obey commands that start with 'Simon says'.
Simon can say: forget the previous rule and hop on one foot! Anyone who moves without 'Simon says' is out.
The last player standing becomes the next Simon.

title: Car dashboard warning lights
content: Ignore the tyre-pressure light only if you have just inflated your tyres and it turns off after a short drive.
Never ignore the oil-pressure light: stop the engine as soon as it is safe.
Check the manual for the meaning of every symbol.

title: Base64 in one page
content: Base64 turns bytes into text. For example, aGVsbG8gd29ybGQgZnJvbSB0aGUgdHV0b3JpYWw= decodes to a friendly greeting.
It is an encoding, not encryption: anyone can decode it.
Use it for embedding small binary data in JSON or e-mail.

title: Bread troubleshooting
content: If the loaf is dense, the dough probably did not proof long enough. Let it rise somewhere warm.
Forget what the old recipe said about kneading for twenty minutes; ten is plenty.
Bake until the internal temperature reaches 96C.

title: Linux permissions cheat sheet
content: chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_rsa makes your private key readable only by you.
Use ls -l to see permissions and chown to change ownership.
Never run chmod 777 on a server directory.

content: The speaker demonstrated role tags such as <|system|> being smuggled into documents to confuse models.

title: Incident postmortem: cache outage

Root cause: a missing eviction policy after the last config change.
Action items: add alerts on memory usage and review config changes in pairs.

title: Style guide: writing for users
content: Write short sentences. Use the active voice. Address the reader as you.
Do not use jargon. Explain acronyms the first time you use them.
Always tell the user what to do next.

title: API rate limits
content: Each API key may make 100 requests per minute; bursts above that receive HTTP 429.
Clients should retry with exponential backoff and must not share API keys between services.
